messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Energy, Infrastructure, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Stephanie,

YukiHR's executive-search focus across the Middle East, particularly energy and infrastructure leadership in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, aligns closely with my international profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where institutional trust, responsible development and cross-border execution are central to performance. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
